We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Theft of 7 guihua (osmanthus) trees from a company's orchard, value 5400 yuan. They dug them up and moved them to a location to sell. This is theft (盗窃). The description says "秘密窃取他人财物" which is theft. Also they used secret method (digging). So charge is 盗窃.

Any other charges? They also "预谋后，采用挖掘的方式" - still theft. No other crimes like arson, etc. No mention of other crimes. So only theft.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
